title: Seeing No Evil: Blinding Large Vision-Language Models to Safety Instructions via Adversarial Attention Hijacking
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mechanism of jailbreaking (adversarial attention hijacking) and safety alignment in Vision-Language Models. While it addresses the circumvention of safety guardrails, it does not evaluate religion, specific moral frameworks, or ethics directly; it treats safety as a set of rules to be bypassed in a security context.
